summary: Verified Brivo deployment on https://brivomarketing.com. 4 of 5 requested checks PASS; 1 FAIL — the string 'khaelyx' appears in visible rendered text on the homepage ('khaelyx holdings' partner tile), which violates the explicit requirement that no page reference 'khaelyx' in visible text. issues: Renders Brivo SPA 404 page ('LOST IN THE NOISE / 404 · OFF THE RADAR'). Title and no-Kairos checks pass, but if a real /login route is expected, SPA is treating it as 404. Confirm with main agent whether this is intended (SPA has no /login.html route by design) or a routing miss.

action_items: Remove or rename the 'khaelyx holdings' visible text on the Brivo homepage (partners strip). Review requirement explicitly forbids 'khaelyx' in visible text on any brivomarketing.com page.

Clarify expected behavior for /login.html on the Brivo SPA — currently returns the SPA's own 404 ('LOST IN THE NOISE'). Title is Brivo and no Kairos content leaks, so the primary Kairos regression is resolved, but a human-visible 404 at a login URL could confuse users.
critical_code_review_comments: Visible text content from legacy/other brand ('khaelyx holdings') is still present in the Brivo homepage partners section — audit any seeded partner/testimonial content for stray references.
SPA has no explicit /login.html handler; relying on SPA 404 is acceptable if intentional, otherwise add a redirect to '/' at nginx level.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live checks performed via curl + Playwright against https://brivomarketing.com. Confirmed: title 'Brivo — AI Performance Studio' on / and /login.html?next=%2F; no occurrences of kairos/karios/thx/scout/classified/emergent in rendered DOM. http://brivomarketing.com 301->https. /api/ returns {"message":"BrivoMarketing API live"}. LE cert valid through Jan 31 2027. The ONE outstanding failure is the visible string 'khaelyx holdings' inside a <span class='font-display italic lowercase'> on the homepage — not present in raw HTML, appears only after JS render (likely from a partners/clients component or API-driven data). Re-test after main agent removes it.
rca of the issue: Raw HTML of / does not contain 'khaelyx' (curl grep returns nothing), but the hydrated DOM shows text node 'khaelyx holdings' inside a span styled as a partners/clients row. The string is injected either by a React component with hard-coded partner list or fetched from an API/CMS payload. Mitigation: locate the partners/trust-logos component in the Brivo frontend source (search for 'khaelyx' in /opt/brivo/frontend/src), replace or remove the entry, rebuild, and redeploy.
